items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Pazjo was leading the band, you understand? We used about six pieces. Then the next day we went and played our last job at the auditorium and we played, the same band went back.

ctx.x: We were talking about the, was it Pritchard's band or was it a symphony orchestra or something?

Pritchard he tried to arrange a symphony orchestra, yes sir. He was doing nicely with it. The Grand Lodge gave a session, I had the convention out in Shreveport. We went out there and played at that big auditorium, it sounded fine. And that night we played two nights out there for them. First night after we played the concert then they gave a dance. Well they didn't use all of them, they just used the Dixieland band. Pazjo was leading the band, you understand? We used about six pieces. Then the next day we went…
I remember once you told me Mr. Blanchard, did you call him Professor of the Pianist?
